correctness.rationale: The invariant is the exact outside-neighbor-at-most-one (P3-convexity) condition. The supplied certify.py constructs all rooted tree shapes recursively from multisets of smaller shapes, takes canonical unrooted center encodings, adds every nonedge, and tests all 2^n subsets for each resulting unicyclic graph. A SEPARATE independent enumeration through networkx.nonisomorphic_trees reproduced every rooted-unicyclic instance for n=3..10: 1,6,18,60,165,483,1316,3816 tree-plus-nonedge cases, the unique cycle maximal counts 5,10,17,29,51,90,158,277, and no competing tie. Four-state cyclic forbidden-101 trace has characteristic polynomial λ(λ³−2λ²+λ−1); recurrence yields c11=486. Hub conditioning gives N(Qn)=2^(n−2)+2n−2, with Q11=532, while c_(n+1)<2c_n permits strict induction for all n>=11. The code covers only n<=10; the transfer argument is essential for the infinite family.
residual_risks: The finite proof depends on complete generation/deduplication, independently reconstructed and checked through n=10; no closed-form higher-order global maxima are claimed.
